author: Bobby Grayson
description: All four are documented in the translator header or the source comments; none needed a core change.
title: Translator limits found by the registry: (1) @type reply is one Lean type per file, so lookup answers {:found, pid} | :not_found instead of pid | nil (a tagged union Reply); (2) Msg tags are global across modules, so the client's message could not be {:register, name()} while Reg's call is (renamed :claim); (3) a map pattern's whole map is unreachable from the source without the new %{..} = m alias; (4) 'from' is a Lean keyword: a hand model must not name a binder from (the translator renders from_)
